description: Amazon Ad Tag conversion loader on s.amazon-adsystem.com/iu3/conversion, whose Tag ID rides in the path. APS apstag.js is not contracted. Firefly viewability hops are vendor/amazon-vfw.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: It is the Amazon DSP Tag ID. Amazon documents Tag IDs in the Advertising Tag GTM template. Generated loaders put that ID in `/iu3/conversion/{id}.js`, so this rule is ecosystem evidence.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Tag ID from Amazon DSP so the path is `/iu3/conversion/{Tag ID}.js`.
